name: get_time_off_balance
description: Retrieves current available time off balances, unit of measure (hours or days), and plan categories for a worker across eligible absence plans (e.g. Vacation, Sick, Floating Holiday).

worker_id.description: Workday ID (WID) or employee ID of the worker. If omitted, queries the logged-in user.

effective_date.description: Effective date for the balance calculation in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to current date.
